name: InterconnectSettlementReconciler
tagline: Check every carrier invoice against your CDRs, dispute what is wrong inside the window and settle the rest – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete wholesale interconnect settlement app for Power Apps and Power Pages: carrier invoice lines compared with your switch / mediation volumes and agreed rates, tolerance-based auto-match, a variance bridge that splits volume and rate effects, disputes with windows, ageing and SLA, approval limits, a settlement pipeline board and the net position per carrier and period. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode) and binds to any settlement table in a few clicks.
features: 10 clickable KPIs per traffic period: to reconcile, within tolerance %, open variance, disputed value, disputes over SLA, net position
Tolerance matching by % and amount, single line or bulk Auto-match
Variance bridge: expected → volume effect → rate / rounding effect → invoiced, with the rate implied by the invoice
Payable and receivable lines with the net position per carrier
Disputes with dispute window countdown, ageing buckets, SLA bars, credits agreed and recovered value
Workflow rules: match only within tolerance, dispute reference, approval limit with named approver, payment reference to settle
Drag and drop pipeline with allowed / not-allowed feedback and a keyboard Move menu
Bulk approve and analyst assignment, CSV export, undo and automatic audit notes
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen reader support
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control from one src/app)
